title: ㄹ의 두 소리: 라면의 ㄹ, 물의 ㄹ
objective: Read ㄹ as [r] before a vowel, [l] at the end, [ll] when doubled, and carry a final ㄹ over to ㅇ.
summary: Learn when ㄹ sounds like [r] and when it sounds like [l].

task.title: Read and sound out ㄹ
task.line: Say each word aloud first, then write the sound or answer it asks for.

letters.sound: [r] – a quick, light tap of the tongue
[l] – tongue tip stays on the roof
letters.as: like l in 'feel', not rolled: 물 [mul]

letters.sound: ㄹ moves to the next syllable and becomes [r]

exercises: Is the ㄹ [r] or [l]? ① 오리 ② 발 ③ 하루
Write how it sounds in [ ]: ① 말이 ② 길을 ③ 달이
Choose the word with a long [ll] sound: ① 다리 / 달리다 ② 머리 / 멀리
Read aloud. Write each ㄹ sound in order ([r], [l] or [ll]): ① 고릴라 ② 일요일 ③ 놀이
